[P2] Match public suspensions across intervening retry resumes

A public wait/callback can start in invocation A, remain outstanding while retry backoff wakes invocation B, and complete before invocation C. This code selects B for A and rejects the later completion; processing B then rejects the operation because it started before B. The empty mapping makes `build_evidence()` report `suspensionCheckpointMatches=false` and, for timers, `durableWaitObserved=false`, incorrectly failing requirement 5. Track outstanding operation identities across intervening requests and match completion to the subsequent native resume. Add a three-invocation regression covering this sequence.
